inter_annotator_agreement_note: Not applicable: single-author study has no second independent annotator; do not report Cohen's κ as dual-rater reliability.
paper_claim_boundary_statement: The human pair audit is a stratified 50-pair single-author annotation under blinded packet presentation (metadata scrubbed; sides randomized). It supports qualitative evidence-coupled error analysis and author-facing case review. It is not independent dual-rater gold, does not report inter-annotator Cohen's κ, is not a prevalence estimate for PrimeVul, is not AI pilot labeling, and must not be promoted as a model-quality benchmark or replacement for the pair-coupled decoding mainline metrics.
